cawsRules.ruleText: Community funds must be transparent
No diverting donations for personal use
Events must actually happen as promised
Beneficiaries must be real, not ghost names
Impact reports must be truthful
No bribery or corruption
Public budgets must be published
Services promised must be delivered
No using office for personal enrichment
Health data must be protected
Vulnerable populations must be protected with dignity
Case files are confidential
Environmental violations must be reported
No extortion or harassment of citizens
No checkpoint bribery or illegal roadblocks
Use of force must be proportional and justified
Evidence must be handled with integrity
Emergency response must be swift and professional
Traffic enforcement must be fair, not selective
Immigration processing must be fair and humane
Client confidentiality is sacred (lawyer-client privilege)
No abandoning clients mid-case for non-payment
No bribing judges or falsifying evidence
Judges must remain impartial (no accepting bribes)
Judgments must be based on law and evidence, not bias
Military must protect civilians, not harm them
No looting or theft during military operations
Follow rules of engagement and international law
Customs officers must not facilitate smuggling
No torture or inhumane treatment of inmates
Inmates have right to medical care and family visits
Prison conditions must meet minimum human standards
No malicious prosecution or withholding exonerating evidence

dashboardLayout.welcomeMessage: Voice of the People, {requestsWaiting} citizens need your service. {projectsActive} programs running. {budgetTransparency} public funds tracked. Serve with honor.
